result.coverage: GST booked in the books, not a return figure: per voucher, the entries on Duties & Taxes ledgers whose master carries a recognised GST duty head, totalled against the one ledger on that voucher under Purchase Accounts, Direct Expenses, Indirect Expenses or Fixed Assets (groups a live capture has shown on a purchase), only on a Purchase, Debit Note, Journal or Payment that has a Sundry Creditors ledger on it; debit_side_tax is negative as the books state it and credit_side_tax positive, never netted; a voucher with no such single ledger, or one these rules cannot read with certainty, is set aside under its reason with its own totals; nothing is apportioned; GST booked to a ledger outside Duties & Taxes, or to a ledger with no recognised head, is not attributed; eligibility, availment, input versus output and any return table are not decided
